description: This is a test file written in TypeScript that uses Vitest for testing functionality related to processing fenced code blocks and text chunking in a project. It imports testing utilities and functions from a helper module, and contains two test cases verifying behavior of fenced block splitting and chunking logic.

methods.name: subscribeEmbeddedPiSession
methods.description: A test suite describing the behavior of the embedded Pi session subscription, focusing on fenced code block handling and text chunking.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for verifying split and chunking logic within fenced code blocks.

methods.name: expectFencedChunks
methods.description: Utility function to verify correct identification of fenced chunks.

methods.name: createParagraphChunkedBlockReplyHarness
methods.description: Creates a test harness for paragraph chunking and block reply handling.

methods.name: emitAssistantTextDeltaAndEnd
methods.description: Simulates emitting text with specific chunking parameters and ending the input.
